message.Title: Generally Available: Premium v2 tier in Azure API Management

Body.Content:
Announcing the general availability of the Azure API Management Premium v2 tier, our most powerful and scalable option for managing APIs at enterprise scale. 

Premium v2 delivers superior performance, the highest entity limits, unlimited included API calls, and the most comprehensive feature set across all tiers. Designed for large, business-critical API programs, it provides the scale, reliability, and security needed to run enterprise-wide API initiatives with confidence. 

Built on a modernized architecture, Premium v2 separates management traffic from the customer’s virtual network, making private networking both more secure and simpler to configure. 

Learn more:
  • About this high-performance API management tier.
  • Explore pricing details.
